source.dataset: Union of curated FAO, EPPO, USDA Ag100Pest/CAPS/APHIS, WOAH and PHI-base records
source.scope: Agricultural organisms in a source-linked union catalogue covering crops, livestock, aquaculture, forestry, stored products and plant-health priorities. One primary display role per taxon; documented biological-control organisms are separated from pests. This is not an exhaustive list.
source.matching: Current GenBank chromosome/complete assemblies. Species-level matching includes varieties, breeds and wild samples of listed taxa; only explicit aliases and named cultivated hybrids are included.
